name: validateNumberSeparators

props.name: allowEmpty
props.description: `true` to allow empty string.

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `TextInput` component

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Optional starting value for uncontrolled state Defaults to 0 when type="number" Defaults to NaN when type="text"

props.name: disableWheel
props.description: Specify if the wheel functionality for the input should be disabled, or not

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify if the control should be disabled, or not

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: **Experimental:** Specify Intl.NumberFormat options applied to internal number parsing and formatting. Use with `type="text"`, has no effect when `type="number"`.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Provide text that is used alongside the control label for additional help

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Specify whether you want the underlying label to be visually hidden

props.name: hideSteppers
props.description: Specify whether you want the steppers to be hidden

props.name: iconDescription
props.description: Provide a description for up/down icons that can be read by screen readers

props.name: inputMode
props.description: Instruct the browser which keyboard to display on mobile devices. Defaults to `decimal`, but note that standard numeric keyboards vary across devices and operating systems.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify if the currently value is invalid.

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Message which is displayed if the value is invalid.

props.name: label
props.description: Generic `label` that will be used as the textual representation of what this field is for

props.name: light
props.description: `true` to use the light version. been deprecated in v11 in favor of the new `Layer` component. It will be removed in the next major release.

props.name: locale
props.description: **Experimental:** Specify a [BCP47](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/bcp/bcp47.txt) language code for parsing and formatting. Use with `type="text"`, has no effect when `type="number"`.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum value.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum value.

props.name: pattern
props.description: When type="text", provide an optional pattern to restrict user input. Has no effect when type="number".

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Specify if the component should be read-only

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the Number Input.

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `TextInput` component

props.name: step
props.description: Specify how much the values should increase/decrease upon clicking on up/down button

props.name: stepStartValue
props.description: Provide the value stepping should begin at when the input is empty

props.name: type
props.description: **Experimental**: Specify if the input should be of type text or number. Use type="text" with `locale`, `formatOptions`, and guide user input with `pattern` and `inputMode`.

props.name: validate
props.description: Optional validation function that is called with the input value and locale. This is called before other validations, giving consumers the ability to short-circuit or extend validation without replacing built-in rules // Using the built-in separator validation <NumberInput validate={validateNumberSeparators} /> // Combining with custom validation <NumberInput validate={(value, locale) => { return validateNumberSeparators(value, locale) && customValidation(value) }} /> - Return `false` to immediately fail validation. - Return `true` to pass this validation, but still run other checks (min, max, required, etc.). - Return `undefined` to defer entirely to built-in validation logic.

props.name: value
props.description: Specify the value of the input

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently in warning state

props.name: warnText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in warning state

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon validateNumberSeparators rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
